An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing a cryptographic beacon that broadcasts periodic proof-of-stake challenges. Agents must lock
 collateral within an opal smart contract to validate transactions. A decentralized mirror network then audits agent outputs against historical behaviors. An attacker attempting to flood the system with fake identities faces prohibitive capital lock-up costs and slashing risks, rendering mass Sybil creation economically unviable.
